_ui.title: Bible in One Scroll — the film
_ui.sub: From creation to the new heaven and new earth — 21 scenes, each painted in its own style, tell one story. The pictures are drawn live in your browser.

ch: Is the Bible a True Story?
_ui.shareText: From creation to the new heaven and new earth — the Bible story in 13 minutes

evidence.18 · 성경은 실화인가: 18  ·  Is the Bible a True Story?
evidence.성경이 진짜 실화인가요?: Is the Bible really a true story?
evidence.40여 명의 저자 — 왕·목자·어부·세리·의사: some 40 authors — kings, shepherds, fishermen, a tax collector, a physician
evidence.왕·목자·어부·세리·의사: kings, shepherds, fishermen, a tax collector, a physician
evidence.그런데도 ‘그리스도를 통한 구원’이라는 하나의 주제로 흐트러짐 없이 모입: Yet it all converges, without disarray, on one theme: salvation through Christ.
evidence.그런데도 ‘그리스도를 통한 구원’이라는\n하나의 주제로 흐트러짐 없이 모:
Yet it all converges, without disarray,
on one theme: salvation through Christ.
It keeps being confirmed from the ground (archaeology).
It is the best-preserved ancient document (manuscripts).
evidence.사해문서 이사야 사본 ↔ 표준 사본: Dead Sea Isaiah scroll  ↔  standard text
evidence.베들레헴 출생 · 고난받는 종: birth in Bethlehem · the suffering servant
evidence.이 근거들은 성경을 믿는 것이\n비합리적이지 않고 오히려 합리적임을 보여:
These grounds show that believing the Bible
is not irrational but reasonable;
evidence.이 근거들은 성경을 믿는 것이 비합리적이지 않고\n오히려 합리적임을 보여:
These grounds show that believing
the Bible is not irrational but reasonable;
they are not a “proof” that compels
like a mathematical formula.
evidence.“믿음은 들음에서 나며\n들음은 그리스도의 말씀으로 말미암았느니라”:
“Faith comes from hearing,
and hearing through the word of Christ”

exile.이스라엘이 다윗의 집을 배반하여\n오늘까지 이르렀더라:

exile.우리가 바벨론의 여러 강변 거기에 앉아서\n시온을 기억하며 울었도다:

exile.그 중의 버드나무에 우리가 우리의 수금을 걸었나니: On the willows there we hung up our lyres.

He went with them even into the darkest land of exile, and promised restoration.
He went with them even into the darkest land
of exile, and promised restoration.

exodus.“이스라엘 자손이 바다 가운데를 육지로 걸어가고”: “the people of Israel went into the midst of the sea on dry ground”

exodus.“물은 그들의 좌우에 벽이 되니”:

fall.“여호와 하나님의 낯을 피하여\n동산 나무 사이에 숨은지라”:
“hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God
among the trees of the garden”
fall.“여자의 후손은 네 머리를 상하게 할 것이요”:
“… between your offspring and her offspring;
he shall bruise your head”
fall.“여자의 후손은\n네 머리를 상하게 할 것이요”:
“… between your offspring and her offspring;
he shall bruise your head”
fall.타락 직후 주신 첫 복음의 약속: The first promise of the gospel, given right after the Fall

gospel.“의인은 없나니 하나도 없으며 … 모든 사람이 죄를 범하였으매 하나님의: “None is righteous, no, not one … for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God”
gospel.“율법으로는 죄를 깨달음이니라 … 율법이 우리를 그리스도께로 인도하는 초: “through the law comes knowledge of sin … the law was our guardian until Christ came”
gospel.“너희는 그 은혜에 의하여 믿음으로 말미암아 구원을 받았으니 … 행위에서: “by grace you have been saved through faith … not a result of works”
gospel.“우리가 믿음으로 의롭다 하심을 받았으니 … 의롭게 되는 것은 율법의 행: “since we have been justified by faith … a person is not justified by works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ”
gospel.“이 성경이 곧 내게 대하여 증언하는 것이니라 … 모든 성경에 쓴 바 자: “it is they that bear witness about me … he interpreted to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself”
gospel.“때가 찼고 하나님의 나라가 가까이 왔으니 회개하고 복음을 믿으라”: “The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand; repent and believe in the gospel”
gospel.사다리가 아니라 거울: Not a ladder but a mirror

This love is not information but an invitation.
I admit I am a sinner who cannot save myself.
I admit I am a sinner
who cannot save myself.

I believe Jesus died on the cross for me and rose again.

for me and rose again.

Please forgive all my sins, and from now on be the Lord of my life.

and from now on be the Lord of my life.
and from now on be the Lord of my life.

Receive me as Your child,
and let me live a new life.
and let me live a new life.

yet every time they cried out
he sent a rescuer and raised them up.

Jesus comes again and makes all things new.

renewal.“애통하는 것이나 곡하는 것이나 아픈 것이 다시 있지 아니하리니”: “neither shall there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain anymore”
renewal.“보라 내가 만물을 새롭게 하노라”: “Behold, I am making all things new”

ship.예수님 안 믿어도,\n그냥 착하게 살면 되는 것 아닌가요?:
Can’t I just live a good life
without believing in Jesus?
ship.예수님 안 믿어도,\n그냥 착하게 살면\n되는 것 아닌가요?:
Can’t I just live
a good life without
believing in Jesus?
Suppose you’re aboard a pirate ship.
ship.그 배 위에서 아무리 갑판을 깨끗이 닦고, 동료에게 친절하고,\n누구보다:
No matter how spotless you keep the deck, how kind you are to the crew,
how exemplary your life —
ship.그 배 위에서 아무리 갑판을 깨끗이 닦고,\n동료에게 친절하고, 누구보다:
No matter how spotless you keep the deck, how kind
you are to the crew, how exemplary your life —
because you’re carried along with the ship
to where it’s headed (the harbor of judgment).
The problem is not a “score of behavior”
but “which ship you belong to” (your identity).
So the gospel doesn’t say “try harder to be good”;
it says “change ships.”
ship.죄의 배에서 내려, 예수님께로 —\n하나님의 자녀라는 새 신분으로 건너가:
Get off the ship of sin and cross over to Jesus —
into the new identity of a child of God.
ship.“그가 우리를 흑암의 권세에서 건져내사\n그의 사랑의 아들의 나라로 옮기:
“He has delivered us from the domain of darkness
and transferred us to the kingdom of his beloved Son”

Yet the stage was quietly being set.
silence.“때가 차매 하나님이 그 아들을 보내사\n여자에게서 나게 하시고”:
“But when the fullness of time had come,
God sent forth his Son, born of woman”

wilderness.“너희를 내 백성으로 삼고: “I will take you to be my people,
wilderness.나는 너희의 하나님이 되리니”: and I will be your God”

wilderness.약속의 땅 문 앞에 선 백성,\n이제 들어갑니다…:
Standing at the edge of the promised land,
they prepare to enter…
wilderness.“사람이 자기의 아들을 안는 것 같이\n너희의 하나님 여호와께서:
“the LORD your God carried you,
as a man carries his son,
wilderness.너희가 걸어온 길에서 너희를 안으사\n이 곳까지 이르게 하셨느니라”:
all the way that you went
until you came to this place.”
